description: This file defines the Concatenate class with static methods for text manipulation functions such as CONCATENATE, TEXTJOIN, and REPT, used in spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Concatenate
classes.description: Provides static methods for text concatenation, joining, and repetition functions used in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: CONCATENATE
methods.description: Concatenates multiple arguments into a single string, handling errors and maximum string length.

methods.name: TEXTJOIN
methods.description: Joins multiple strings with a delimiter, optionally ignoring empty values, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: builtinREPT
methods.description: Repeats a string a specified number of times, with error handling for invalid inputs.
